description: Production-grade plugin hooks: cross-session project enforcement (SessionStart) and oracle-gate inner-loop enforcement (PostToolUse, loop-protocol Rule 7). Commands resolve the plugin root by waterfall (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, then CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, then the Claude Code cache scan) and degrade to silence when no root resolves — the same hooks.json is read by Claude Code and mirrored for Codex.

hooks.command: _R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -z "$_R" ] && _R=$(for d in "$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/nagisanzenin/production-grade"/*/; do [ -f "$d/hooks/session-guard.sh" ] && echo "$d"; done | sort -V | tail -1); _R="${_R%/}"; if [ -n "$_R" ] && [ -f "$_R/hooks/session-guard.sh" ]; then bash "$_R/hooks/session-guard.sh"; fi

_R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -z "$_R" ] && _R=$(for d in "$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/nagisanzenin/production-grade"/*/; do [ -f "$d/hooks/oracle-gate.sh" ] && echo "$d"; done | sort -V | tail -1); _R="${_R%/}"; if [ -n "$_R" ] && [ -f "$_R/hooks/oracle-gate.sh" ]; then bash "$_R/hooks/oracle-gate.sh"; fi
